Lena Park: quick FYI: after last night's kernel packing change we saw short-seq p99 jump 68ms -> 89ms. digging host-side.
Omar Khan: which change? more packing per kernel?
Lena Park: PACKER_POLAR=high (pack up to 10). Also adaptive-slice min=128B enabled.
Priya Rao: perf top snippet:
```
 parse_frame 33%
 writev_flush 24%
 kv_lookup 10%
 tokenize 8%
```
Lena Park: writev calls doubled, kv hot-evictions up 2.9x.
Omar Khan: hypothesis: denser kernel packing increases backend compute jitter -> host preproc emits many small fragments -> more writev + kv churn.
Priya Rao: quick canary configs tested:
A) PACK_LIMIT=4
B) PACKER=high + STREAM_CHUNK=512 + WRITEV_COALESCE=1
perf-bot: canary B: writev -57%, kv_evictions -61%, short-p99 -14ms.
Lena Park: plan: default to coalesce+512B, add pack-affinity hint from kernel selector, add rollout guard (kv.hitrate>0.82 && writev_rate<400/s). Uploading traces now. :thumbsup:
